<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Design an 8-bit unsigned multiplier using pipelined processing. Implement sequential logic for input control, input registers, partial product generation, partial sum calculation, final product calculation, and output assignment.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal for chip reset.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal controlling the multiplication process.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplicand input with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplier input with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal indicating if the multiplication process is enabled.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output with a data width of 16 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">0</parameter>
        <parameter id="LOAD">1</parameter>
        <parameter id="CALCULATE">2</parameter>
        <parameter id="OUTPUT">3</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="mul_en_out_reg" width_description="[3:0]">Register to store the output enable signal.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_a_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the multiplicand input.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_b_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the multiplier input.</reg>
        <wire id="temp[0]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to store the first partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[1]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to store the second partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[2]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to store the third partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[3]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to store the fourth partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[4]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to store the fifth partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[5]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to store the sixth partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[6]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to store the seventh partial product.</wire>
        <wire id="temp[7]" width_description="[15:0]">Wire to store the eighth partial product.</wire>
        <reg id="sum[0]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to store the first partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[1]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to store the second partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[2]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to store the third partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[3]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to store the fourth partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[4]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to store the fifth partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="sum[5]" width_description="[15:0]">Register to store the sixth partial sum.</reg>
        <reg id="mul_out_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Register to store the final product output.</reg>
        
        // Sequential Logic Block
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_en_out_reg <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                mul_en_out_reg <= {mul_en_out_reg[2:0], mul_en_in};
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational Logic Block
        always @(*) begin
            case(mul_en_out_reg[3])
                LOAD: begin
                    mul_a_reg = mul_a;
                    mul_b_reg = mul_b;
                end
                CALCULATE: begin
                    mul_a_reg = mul_a_reg;
                    mul_b_reg = mul_b_reg;
                end
                default: begin
                    mul_a_reg = mul_a_reg;
                    mul_b_reg = mul_b_reg;
                end
            endcase
        end
        
        // Partial Product Generation
        genvar i;
        generate
            for(i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : pp_gen
                assign temp[i] = (mul_b_reg[i]) ? {{8{1'b0}}, mul_a_reg} << i : 16'd0;
            end
        endgenerate
        
        // Partial Sum Calculation
        always @(posedge clk) begin
            sum[0] <= temp[0];
            sum[1] <= temp[1] + temp[2];
            sum[2] <= temp[3] + temp[4];
            sum[3] <= temp[5] + temp[6];
            sum[4] <= temp[7];
        end
        
        // Final Product Calculation
        always @(posedge clk) begin
            mul_out_reg <= sum[0] + sum[1] + sum[2] + sum[3] + sum[4];
        end
        
        // Output Assignment
        assign mul_out = (mul_en_out_reg[3]) ? mul_out_reg : 16'd0;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implement sequential logic for input control, input registers, partial product generation, partial sum calculation, final product calculation, and output assignment.</implementation>
</module>
